block.title: Already out: the manta idling on a gold-ribbed sea, abyss silent below
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen 16:9 arcade composition, subtle CRT scanline glow; ending scene painted at hi-resolution, post-storm stillness, ultra-detailed large-format art with pixel-art texture accents. A split-frame world: the upper half is an ocean laid flat under a sunrise so pale it is almost a color idea — long thin rose-gold cloud bars strung across a cream-to-navy sky, the small half-sun just risen, everything lit gently. On the water sits a flat ray-winged manta fighter, pale mint hull scuffed and steaming faintly where black water beads off it, canopy open with the cockpit a small square of shadow, twin engine rings dark, riding the swell exactly level as though the sea were a parking pad at the end of the universe; around it, the last rings of its surfacing spread outward in two slow concentric outlines, and a scatter of silver droplets still hangs airborne at the waterline, frozen mid-fall, each one holding a pinpoint of sunrise. The lower half of the frame is the water seen from just at its surface, and down there: a deepening wall from teal to true midnight, faintly, far below, the suggestion of what the ship escaped — the dimest hint of a vast sunken angular shadow, a drowned citadel outline, unlit, still, smaller than it should be, dissolving into the blue-black. Light belongs entirely to the top world now. Palette of cream, pale gold and rose above, committed teal-to-midnight blues below, thick dark outlines at the waterline seam, lifted deep-navy depths, never pure black. No text, no letters, no UI.

block.notes: Cloud-bars rose ~#f0c8d0 over cream #fce8b8; depth wall #16485a to near-navy-black; drowned shadow must be ambiguous — if it resolves into readable geometry it stops being a memory and starts being a sequel hook. The open dark canopy is the "resting" tell. Flux.1's soft-light bias actually helps the "color idea" sunrise; keep guidance 3.5.
